activity.notes: Ala ad-Din Muhammad II succeeded Tekish in 1200 and ruled the Khwarazmian state until 1220. Encyclopaedia Iranica explicitly gives his reign as 596–617 AH / 1200–20, so ATLAS uses those year-level boundaries and reuses the existing Khwarazmian Empire polity.

sources.citation_text: Iranica identifies Ala al-Din Muhammad ibn Tekish as Khwarazmshah ruling Khwarazm, Transoxania and Iran in 1200–1220.
